notes.title: Rotational Controls added to demo
notes.content:
A few people requested rotational controls, and keyboard mapping matching the Atari ST Oids game.
It is done. (Rotational controls can be selected from the settings menu)

For high score chasers I made the bonus scoring clearer and added in game score/accuracy display.

There's now a bonus related to how few times you engage the shields.
